_doc: Generic project grouping for the Watchtower dashboard. Each group collapses its member repos into ONE tile on the dashboard; the tile links to the group's hub page (projects/<group>/), which indexes linked module sub-pages (projects/<group>/<module>/). Members never get their own tiles. Add future groups the same way — no code changes needed.

castle.description: Castle is the DOGS home-server platform: it replaces the router and the cloud at the same time. One box behind the ISP modem handles routing, firewall, DNS filtering, and network storage — with a single app to run it all.

modules.blurb: The operating system underneath Castle. Ships headless CLI-only, or with a GUI on a Wayland compositor.
modules.title: Castle OS

modules.blurb: One control plane for everything Castle: iOS, Android, and web. Configure the box, browse files, manage users and security.
modules.title: Castle App

modules.blurb: Tag every flash drive by USB serial (or a composite fingerprint when serials are blank), log sightings, and keep timestamped immutable backups that refresh on plug-in. Unknown drives are logged and flagged — never auto-trusted.
modules.title: Drive Librarian

modules.blurb: The router replacement: DHCP, DNS, firewall, VLANs, QoS, Pi-hole-style blocking, and quota-controlled duplicate-download caching — everything behind the ISP modem, no silent TLS interception.
modules.title: Gateway

castle.tagline: Your data, your network, your rules.
castle.title: Castle
